name: Mask trick-or-treater

body.title: Eric Rigged 001
body.creator: Renderpeople
body.changes: Removed human face and neck; clothing darkened and made matte; cloth mesh simplified; fingers and twist joints merged; dark gloves; 22-joint OLLY OLLY animation rig.

locomotion: Idle, Walk and Run from the existing Winterline Mixamo / Three.js Soldier conversion; hunched and resampled in OLLY OLLY's Jack pipeline.
authoredForGame: Four pull-over rubber masks (skull, old man, devil, ghoul) sculpted in Blender from the scan's own head and baked to texture; black satin hood, collar and cape; a pillowcase; Jack Lunge, Window, Climb, Vault, Stagger and Rise clips.
